title: CLI becomes a consumer of the scanner package
description:
Purpose: @dataparade/cli calls @dataparade/scanner. It does not contain a second copy of the engine.

Stays in the CLI: commander, env/config, write dataflow.json, upload, quota, telemetry, Sentry, AI wrap.

Definition of done: scan <path> on the CLI uses the package. In-tree engine modules are gone from the CLI repo.
